FAQ

Simple answers for gym owners.

What exactly is BRIX Partner?
BRIX Partner is a gym management app for gym owners and staff. You can use it to manage members, fees, renewals, attendance, workout plans, staff and gym reports.
Can I use BRIX only on my phone?
Yes. Starter uses the BRIX Partner mobile app on Android or iPhone. If you also want BRIX on a computer at the front desk, the Web App is included with the Pro plan.
Can BRIX work with biometric attendance?
Yes. Biometric attendance is available in the Pro plan. Device compatibility should be confirmed before setup.
What if I already have members in a notebook or Excel file?
Send your existing records to us. We will help move the available member data into BRIX so you do not have to start again from zero.
What is Brix Fit?
Brix Fit is the member app. It lets members check in, view their membership and follow their workout information from their own phone.
Which plan should I choose?
Starter is for a single gym that wants simple member, payment and renewal management from the mobile app. Pro adds the Web App, multiple branches, biometrics, Brix Fit, workout plans, more staff access and advanced features.
